intro: Public tools and writing I have shared with the developer community, free and MIT-licensed.

items.name: Application Autofill
items.description: A browser userscript that fills Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby job-application forms from a local profile, then leaves the final submit to you. Review-first by design, with no auto-submit and no scraping.

items.name: Agent Skills Collection
items.description: An open collection of reusable AI agent skills for engineers: distributed-systems design review, zero-downtime migration, GenAI production readiness, and time-series forecasting review. Installable with one command.

items.name: Lever Auto-Apply
items.description: Open-source job-application automation with AI resume scoring and a hybrid CAPTCHA workflow. Shared on GitHub for other job seekers to use and extend.

items.name: "I Automated My Job Search Across 7 Job Boards"
items.description: A technical write-up on dev.to walking through how I built and wired together the automation behind my job search, from scraping to AI scoring to an approve-then-send workflow.
